ITEM 1 | Dark green leafy greens, wilted and glossy with moisture, mixed with thin orange shredded strips (carrot-like) and a few pale green stalk pieces, piled in a mound on the left side of the plate, spanning roughly 9 cm by 8 cm, about 2-3 cm tall | 85
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow scrambled eggs, soft curds with some larger clumps and slightly glossy surface, spread in an irregular mound on the right side of the plate, roughly 9 cm by 7 cm, about 2 cm tall, sitting directly on the plate | 110
ITEM 3 | Cylindrical sausage pieces, reddish-brown with a slightly glossy, firm, smooth casing, four to five rounded slices or chunks stacked at the upper right edge, each about 3 cm diameter and 1.5 cm thick, with a darker browned area on the largest piece | 70
